archetypes.name: dyn-plan-size
archetypes.rationale: multi-consumer plan-size trailer and publish guard need cross-surface review
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan-size guardrail changes across plan_quality, design_publish, Step 5c composition, and preflight scanners. Focus on whether oversize_override is preserved through each reader and whether publish fails closed on missing or oversized plan.txt without blocking valid under-threshold plans. Check the interaction between mechanical_churn soft advisories and operator override suppression. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
